mission: Strictly test whether the next candidate RSI laboratory infrastructure and competence hypotheses earn active existence after P0-P3.
questionOrHypothesis: P4-P9: crosscut fault injection, contraction verification, continuous telemetry, Observation tool packaging, semantic applicability after safe binding conflict, and naturally-expensive stopping each survive only if they beat mature/simple baselines without stealing owner/scientific authority.
evidenceSelection: Current ten-project PressurePack; current Host/Runtime/Harness/Game/Security/World source; current Runtime hostDependencies natural distributed workload; real Runtime and Host concurrency probes; exact Git-pinned Observation tool environment; current mature system instrumentation; historical HP4 full snapshot and exact current conformance receipt.
strongBaseline: OS/process fault primitives + Matrix; manual Git contraction checks; systemd/journal/strace/hyperfine and owner receipts; explicit exact Git tool pin; owner current evidence after safe conflict; open adaptive search and zero-evidence fresh synthesis.
negativeControl: Reject any mechanism that merely wraps mature primitives, hides owner semantics, becomes a new authority, encodes materiality after seeing outcomes, depends on Provider wire coercion, or improves cost before semantic acceptance.
candidate: P5 contraction verifier; planning-time applicability basis with mechanical before/after comparison; fresh synthesis boundary after bounded high-information evidence acquisition. P4/P6/P7 infrastructure candidates remain under deletion pressure.
independentOracle: Exact current source/owner contracts and hidden structured claim fields frozen from full source inspection; current Git object/revision/gate identities; semantic success scored before token cost. P8-v1 and P9-v2 wire/representation-contaminated campaigns are excluded wholesale from acceptance.
invalidityConditions: P8 materiality is post-hoc encoded into evidence
P9 Provider schema violations are silently coerced
P9 zero-evidence control matches accepted stopping result
P4 shared DSL erases owner fault meaning
P6 adds telemetry without a natural consumer
authorityBoundary: Computing owns research method/instrument mechanics only. Owners retain truth/effects. P5 verifies Agent-declared contraction, P8 comparison does not decide applicability, and P9 synthesis does not choose the research problem or consequence.
stopRule: Stop after every candidate has a deletion test, P8 has a clean non-oracle-leaking replication, P9 has a zero-evidence control plus checkpoint-size ablation, P5 verifies a real historical contraction and then the current campaign contraction, and final Computing conformance is exact-revision bound.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: Full executable/raw apparatus gets one Git-only snapshot then is removed from current tree. Retain compact battlefields/analyses/reports and only the P5 mechanical verifier in the long-lived Lab surface.
publicationBoundary: No FaultService, TelemetryService, ApplicabilityService, CriticService, stopping scheduler, automatic materiality classifier, or mandatory Observation dependency is authorized.
